name: exit_dfu_silent
precondition: Before t = 0 the last info reply the bootloader received from any peer is the PSoC's reply to 0x09, with the entry mode:application (prior_info): the PSoC responder answers 0x09 with a mode entry, and the Nordic sent no info reply after the PSoC's last one. Only then does a bootloader that reads a query without a reply from the last info reply (N1) fail this check.
